Volume potd: one POTD per sport bubble when that sport has games. Hard Rock price -105 to -135 at selection. No edge requirement (POTD and POTD #n).
Filters: the Alt Line Parlay volume filter and eligible-player rules and bans, plus hit rate at that exact line of at least 7 of last 10, with 8+ of last 10 preferred (the only hit-rate test).
The card carries a "Volume" stamp. The Majors/Today POTD is the best of the Big 4 sport POTDs (NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB).
The official standards still applies: locked only from the morning prop scan, no near-miss or filler, and no POTD at all on a day LineMate data is missing or signed out.
Price drift: a POTD only has to be in band at selection. Later moves of any size never void it. Void only for inactive player or postponed/cancelled game.
A provisional pick that is out of band before lock with no in-band replacement is marked "On hold" and re-checked at lock. It still never voids for drift.

POTD auto-chain: when a sport's POTD settles, a staged pick posts as "POTD #n" (official, locked). Candidates meet the same filters, are pregame with at least 10 min to start, use no game already used by the chain, are in band, and pass a final live Hard Rock check. Nothing qualifies, nothing posts. All Sports POTD does NOT chain. The newest chain pick shows alone in the card.
Every POTD locks when posted at the 7 AM ET publish. A POTD player ruled out before his game is swapped or voided per.
parlay100: Game day process applies to every leg: Game Day Why block, matchup rank (≤20 preferred) and the hard vetoes.

Volume parlay: 2-3 legs. Legs may be ANY real Hard Rock line: a player prop OR a game line (spread, total, moneyline, team total), main or alt, at any price (no per-leg range). No edge requirement. The eligible-prop list does not limit Parlay +100 legs.

Filters: player-prop legs pass the volume/role filter and bans (no TDs, longest-play, blocks/steals, pitcher Ks, hitter unders, questionable players) and hit that exact line in 7+ of the player's last 10. Game-line legs need the team/game to have hit that line in 7+ of its last 10. 7+ of last 10 is the only hit-rate test.

Chain: a parlay that settles (L as soon as any leg loses) is followed by "Parlay +100 #n" built to the same rules, combined +100 to +140, using no game from an earlier parlay that day. The All Sports (Big 4) parlay chains too.
Same-game rule: legs normally come from different games. When only ONE game is on the slate or left, the ticket is built as a same-game parlay PREGAME.
All Sports parlay: safest 2-4 legs, about +100 to +115. Official. Must use different legs and cannot be a pure copy of a sport parlay.

edge: Hard Rock price vs Pinnacle no-vig fair. Edge % = EV% at Hard Rock price. Ranked by edge %. Each pick is locked once posted.
ONE PASS, NO FILLER: Edge runs one pass and posts only plays that qualify. Nothing is filled. This supersedes COUNT's "at least 3" and ALWAYS FILL below.
Qualifying threshold: positive EV at the Hard Rock price, about -130 or better, Pinnacle prices both sides of the same line.

Grade: every Edge play shows a letter grade A..C on line 1 of its row, with the reason in its Why. Player props blend the edge % with a hit-rate model from real recent logs (last 10 + season); game lines and props with no log grade on price, max B+. Thin markets (alts, periods, 3-way) cap at B; fill plays below the bar cap at C+. Grades are display/strength only; ranking stays by edge %.
